method: hair mask: R>150 G>120 B<140 (R-B)>60; contour = mask pixels with >=1 four-neighbour outside mask; peaks = radius local-maxima on angle-sorted contour; accept if radius>equivRadius*1.15, angle-sep>=12.0 deg, prominence>equivRadius*0.1; capCore = morphological opening with a circle-Euclidean structuring element (erode then dilate, radius R px), R sweep 4..24 step 2; plateau = first R whose maxWidthNorm delta < 0.005 and stays < 0.005
